source.title: Planning maintenance at a bus station
source.author: Dual Dictionary project — AI-assisted original source
source.article: The station manager will carry out maintenance on the north entrance escalator next Tuesday. While the work is underway, the escalator will be out of service and signs will direct passengers to the lifts. Staff will inspect the warning boards before the morning rush and report any blocked route to the duty manager. The notice asks passengers to allow a few extra minutes when changing platforms.
